title: Recovery and portability
requirement: Reproduce the tools and recover actual application state on an explicitly chosen host without copying authentication stores or treating old receipts as new acceptance.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: On the destination PC, select a small profile; establish native sign-ins, scoped tool calls and useful tasks, then independently restore application state and keys.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
